title: Official garden guide
summary: Official overview of Berkshire Botanical Garden's 24-acre campus and named display gardens.
description: Used to identify the Edible Gardens, Children's Discovery Garden, greenhouses, woodland and water gardens, and the site's Zone 5b home-gardening context.

rights.note: Project-authored factual record is deployable; the publisher page remains the authoritative original.

title: 2024 self-guided visitor map
summary: One-page numbered visitor map locating the Edible Gardens, Children's Vegetable Garden, greenhouses, paths, buildings, parking, woodland, and other named landmarks.
description: Used with 2019, 2021, and 2025 orthophotos to identify persistent features; schematic artwork was not treated as surveyed geometry.

rights.note: Berkshire Botanical Garden retains copyright. This release links to the authoritative original; the research copy and rendered preview remain private. No open redistribution license is asserted.

title: The Mount gardens
summary: Official interpretation of The Mount's formal gardens and Beatrix Farrand's landscape work.
description: Used to establish the historic estate-garden context and to distinguish the kitchen-garden study from the surviving formal garden rooms.

rights.note: The Mount's terms restrict republication; only the project-authored factual record is deployed.

title: The Mount official location
summary: Official location and contact reference for matching The Mount to the correct Lenox parcel.
description: Used for garden identity and parcel matching, not for interior bed geometry.

rights.note: Only a project-authored factual location record is deployed.

title: SculptureNow at The Mount 2018 estate map
summary: 2018 estate guide and map used to cross-reference stable, lawn, drives, and other persistent estate landmarks.
description: Supports the aerial registration of the former kitchen-garden lawn north of the stable; it does not supply a surveyed kitchen-bed plan.

rights.note: Research copy is retained outside the public build pending permission.

title: Naumkeag property guide
summary: Official visitor and property overview for Naumkeag's house, garden rooms, and public access.
description: Used for site identity, acreage, public-garden context, and named landscape features.

rights.note: Only the project-authored factual record is deployed.

title: Official Naumkeag house and gardens map
summary: One-page property map identifying the house, gardens, visitor facilities, entrance, and surrounding parkland.
description: Used as a broad landmark and circulation reference; the garden-room geometry comes from cross-registration with more detailed sources and aerial imagery.

rights.note: Research copy is retained outside the public build; the local fallback is a project-authored record.

title: Naumkeag's Landscape: A Vision & A View
publisher: The Trustees of Reservations / UMass Amherst
summary: Ten-page landscape tour describing Fletcher Steele and Mabel Choate's outdoor rooms, their sequence, and historic visual evidence.
description: Primary interpretive reference for the Rose Garden, Evergreen Garden, Peony Terraces, Afternoon Garden, Blue Steps, and historic aerial relationships.

rights.copyrightHolder: The Trustees of Reservations / UMass Amherst
rights.note: Research copy is retained outside the public build; locally authored source facts remain available in the application.

title: Cultural Landscape Foundation Naumkeag profile
summary: Landscape-history profile describing Naumkeag's design chronology, designers, and principal garden rooms.
description: Used to cross-check room names, chronology, and spatial sequence rather than exact bed boundaries.

rights.note: Only a project-authored factual record is deployed.

title: National Trust archival Naumkeag garden plans
summary: Archival article presenting plans, sketches, blueprint fragments, and historic aerial evidence for Naumkeag's garden development.
description: Used to check the Blue Steps, garden-room geometry, and the relationship between designed plans and the built landscape.

rights.note: Six cited research images are retained outside the public build; the deployable fallback is a project-authored factual record.

title: Ashintully property guide
summary: Official overview of Ashintully Gardens, its public terrace gardens, woodland setting, and Marble Palace ruins.
description: Used to identify the public garden, establish landscape character, and distinguish the garden parcel from the adjacent private residence.

rights.note: Only the project-authored factual record is deployed.

title: Ashintully public map
summary: Trustees GIS map of the public garden, terrace area, paths, Marble Palace ruins, and private-house exclusion; its printed north orientation is reversed.
description: Used with aerial imagery to select the correct public parcel and register the editable terrace cluster; interior borders and paths remain diagrammatic.

rights.note: Research copy is retained outside the public build; a project-authored source record is deployed.

title: MassGIS Level 3 property tax parcels
summary: Massachusetts statewide standardized assessor parcel geometry used to identify and bound each featured garden parcel.
description: The application stores only the matched public geometry and minimum parcel identifiers; owner and searched-address fields are not retained, and parcel boundaries are not surveys.

rights.note: Project-owned bounded parcel records and factual source metadata are deployed with MassGIS attribution.

title: MassGIS 2019 aerial imagery
summary: Spring 2019 leaf-off, four-band Massachusetts orthophotography used to check persistent paths and planting-grid divisions.
description: A cross-vintage alignment reference for Berkshire Botanical Garden; the application does not treat changing crop edges as surveyed features.

rights.note: MassGIS states that the imagery is available for public use and distribution; attribution is retained.

title: MassGIS 2021 aerial imagery
summary: Spring 2021 leaf-off, 15 cm, four-band statewide orthophotography used for cross-vintage garden alignment.
description: Used at Berkshire Botanical Garden to separate persistent paths and plot divisions from seasonal vegetation and temporary objects.

rights.note: MassGIS source record and bounded delivery contract are retained locally with attribution.

title: MassGIS 2025 aerial imagery
summary: Current MassGIS natural-color and color-infrared aerial reference used for parcel context and garden-feature registration.
description: The studio requests bounded parcel and viewport tile mosaics and caches them; source metadata and alignment observations are checked into the project.

rights.note: MassGIS attribution is retained; bounded project-hosted derivatives can replace the live service.
